Commune record 01001 · 2018 built-property tax

The COBOL computes €137,415 due. The published port computes €144,041.

Same input record, same rates. France's 2018 property-tax calculator (DGFiP's COBOL) runs unmodified under GnuCOBOL as the answer key. A public Java port, co-authored by the Qwen-Coder agent, passes its own built-property tests (4 of 4) and computes a different total.

Where the port departs from the COBOL

Defect 1 · fee rates

The 3% and 8% fee tiers carry each other's rates.

COBOL 3% tier: 3% and 1%. 8% tier: 8% and 4.4%. EFITA3B8.cob:99–102 @ 6bd40b2 Port 3% tier: 8% and 4.4%. 8% tier: 3% and 1%. BuiltPropertyCalculator.java:24–27 @ 5124d1c

Defect 2 · total before fees

The total before fees leaves out the household-waste tax.

COBOL The waste tax is summed into the 8% tier, which enters the total. EFITA3B8.cob:398–408, 479–480 Port Eight levies are summed; the waste tax is not one of them. RetourB.java:95–102 @ 5124d1c

A commune record is one commune's 2018 REI totals and voted rates, reshaped into one calculator input. These are not household bills. Amounts are whole euros, as the calculator returns them.

    Rerun it.
    
  
    # the 408 Ain commune records, from the committed fixtures (Python only, seconds)
git clone https://github.com/Yazan-O/tare && cd tare
python -m tare reproduce --offline

# every commune, fresh: GnuCOBOL, a JDK 17+ and Maven (cases/taxe_fonciere/README.md)
cd cases/taxe_fonciere && python fetch.py --full && cd full
PYTHONPATH=../../.. python -m tare answer-key
PYTHONPATH=../../.. python -m tare reproduce
